scientific_limitations: Only exact linear completed endpoint updates of the one-parameter L-stable branch are analyzed.
The dimension-minimal CTMC examples permit reducible chains; irreducible-chain minimality is not addressed.
No claims for internal stages, nonlinear equations, approximate ADER closure, other temporal families or finite precision.
Novelty is judged against inspected accessible primary literature, published mathematical findings and targeted searches, not certified exhaustive historical priority.
title: A sharp scalar-positivity transition and three-state Markov obstruction for an L-stable fourth-order integrator
